---
Test
---
!3 Créer, consulter, modifier puis supprimer une réservation

!define RESERVATION { {{{
{
  "firstname": "Steve",
  "lastname": "Andriamanambola",
  "totalprice": 150,
  "depositpaid": true,
  "bookingdates": { "checkin": "2026-12-01", "checkout": "2026-12-05" },
  "additionalneeds": "Petit-déjeuner"
}
}}} }

!4 1. Obtenir un jeton
|script          |json http test                                                          |
|set content type|application/json                                                        |
|set value       |application/json        |for header        |Accept                      |
|post            |{"username": "${ADMIN_USER}", "password": "${ADMIN_PASS}"}|to|${BASE_URL}/auth|
|$jeton=         |json path               |token                                          |

!4 2. Créer la réservation
|script                                                                                   |
|post            |${RESERVATION}          |to                |${BASE_URL}/booking         |
|check           |response status         |200                                            |
|$id=            |json path               |bookingid                                      |
|check           |json path               |booking.firstname |Steve                       |
|check           |json path               |booking.totalprice|150                         |
|check           |json path               |booking.bookingdates.checkin|2026-12-01        |

!4 3. La consulter
|script                                                                                   |
|get from        |${BASE_URL}/booking/$id                                                 |
|check           |response status         |200                                            |
|check           |json path               |lastname          |Andriamanambola             |
|check           |json path               |depositpaid       |true                        |

!4 4. La retrouver par recherche
|script                                                                                   |
|get from        |${BASE_URL}/booking?lastname=Andriamanambola                            |
|check           |json path count         |$[?(@.bookingid == $id)]|1                     |

!4 5. Une modification sans jeton est refusée
|script                                                                                   |
|reject          |patch                   |${BASE_URL}/booking/$id|with|{"totalprice": 1} |
|check           |response status         |403                                            |

!4 6. Une modification avec jeton est acceptée
|script                                                                                   |
|set value       |token=$jeton            |for header        |Cookie                      |
|patch           |${BASE_URL}/booking/$id |with              |{"totalprice": 199}         |
|check           |response status         |200                                            |
|check           |json path               |totalprice        |199                         |
|check           |json path               |lastname          |Andriamanambola             |

!4 7. La supprimer
|script                                                                                   |
|delete          |${BASE_URL}/booking/$id                                                 |
|check           |response status         |201                                            |

!4 8. Elle n'existe plus
|script                                                                                   |
|reject          |get from                |${BASE_URL}/booking/$id                        |
|check           |response status         |404                                            |
